description: Evidence-bound AEC dashboards, RFEM 5 COM and RFEM 6 orchestration, CAD/BIM-to-structural pipeline and connectivity audits. Live RFEM requires locally connected Dlubal tools.

interface.defaultPrompt: Prüfe RFEM-, Drive- und GitHub-Capabilities für einen belegten AEC-Workflow.
